label: researched before the demo
title: A public leisure centre runs a waitlist on full group-fitness classes
claim: Active Monash (a council-run leisure provider in Victoria, Australia) runs a waitlist on full group fitness classes and stops accepting cancellations within 1 hour of the class start, so people on the waitlist have time to get there.
source: Active Monash, "Update to Group Fitness Waitlist"
how_verified: Seen in a web search result summary on 14 Nov 2026; the page itself could not be opened from the build session (host not reachable). Open the link to check before relying on it.
not_claimed: No numbers on how often waitlisted people get a spot: the only figures found were from software vendors' blogs and were unsourced.
